templates.title: Publish a lossless WebP
templates.description: Choose a tagged-sRGB or untagged PNG illustration or transparent asset. The WebP decodes to exactly the same pixels, including colour under transparent pixels.

templates.title: Publish an opaque RGB image
templates.description: Opaque RGB sources gain alpha 255; compare image byte counts in the summary before replacing a PNG.

templates.title: Publish a bounded lossy WebP
templates.description: Opaque photographic or gradient PNG, explicit quality, mean RGB error budget and byte budget. Fails with DELIVERABLE_NOT_MET rather than publishing an over-budget file.

templates.title: Decode a WebP to PNG
templates.description: Choose one static simple-format WebP (lossless, or opaque lossy). The PNG holds exactly the samples a fresh trusted dwebp decode gives, including colour under transparent pixels; only dwebp is needed.
